+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _client() -> OpenAI:
+    return OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def _to_float(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return float(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not text:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return float(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _normalize_item(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    quantity = _to_float(item.get("quantity"))
+    unit_price = _to_float(item.get("unit_price") or item.get("unitPrice"))
+    amount = _to_float(item.get("amount") or item.get("total"))
+    normalized = {
+        "description": item.get("description") or item.get("name") or "",
+        "quantity": quantity,
+        "unit_price": unit_price,
+        "amount": amount,
+        "currency": item.get("currency"),
+        "category": item.get("category"),
+    }
+    return {k: v for k, v in normalized.items() if v is not None and v != ""}
+
+
+def normalize_expense(expense_fields: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = _client()
+    prompt = (
+        "Normalize the following extracted expense fields into this JSON schema: "
+        "{vendor, transaction_date, currency, subtotal, tax, tip, total, payment_method, "
+        "last4, items, notes, confidence}. Return only valid JSON. Input: "
+        + json.dumps(expense_fields, ensure_ascii=False)
+    )
+    response = client.responses.create(

+        input=prompt,
+        temperature=0,
+    )
+    text = response.output_text.strip()
+    data = json.loads(text)
+
+    items = data.get("items") or expense_fields.get("items") or []
+    normalized_items = [_normalize_item(item) for item in items if isinstance(item, dict)]
+
+    normalized = {
+        "vendor": data.get("vendor") or expense_fields.get("vendor") or expense_fields.get("merchant"),
+        "transaction_date": data.get("transaction_date") or expense_fields.get("date"),
+        "currency": data.get("currency") or expense_fields.get("currency"),

+        "tax": _to_float(data.get("tax") or expense_fields.get("tax")),
+        "tip": _to_float(data.get("tip") or expense_fields.get("tip")),
+        "total": _to_float(data.get("total") or expense_fields.get("total")),
+        "payment_method": data.get("payment_method") or expense_fields.get("payment_method"),
+        "last4": data.get("last4") or expense_fields.get("last4"),

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _extract_text(receipt_input: Any) -> str:
+    if receipt_input is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(receipt_input, str):
+        return receipt_input.strip()
+    if isinstance(receipt_input, bytes):
+        return receipt_input.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
+    if isinstance(receipt_input, dict):
+        return json.dumps(receipt_input, ensure_ascii=False)
+    return str(receipt_input).strip()
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(receipt_input: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 60) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = (
+        "Extract structured receipt fields as JSON with keys merchant, tax, total, and items. "
+        "items must be an array of objects with name, quantity, unit_price, and total fields when available. "
+        "Return only valid JSON. Receipt text:\n"
+        + _extract_text(receipt_input)
+    )
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": prompt,
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    text = ""
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        output = data.get("output", [])
+        for item in output:
+            if isinstance(item, dict):
+                content = item.get("content", [])
+                for chunk in content:
+                    if isinstance(chunk, dict):
+                        if chunk.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"} and "text" in chunk:
+                            text += chunk["text"]
+        if not text and "output_text" in data:
+            text = data["output_text"] if isinstance(data["output_text"], str) else json.dumps(data["output_text"])
+
+    parsed: Dict[str, Any]
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(text)
+    except Exception:
+        parsed = {"merchant": None, "tax": None, "total": None, "items": [], "raw": text}
+
+    parsed.setdefault("merchant", None)
+    parsed.setdefault("tax", None)
+    parsed.setdefault("total", None)
+    parsed.setdefault("items", [])
+    return parsed
+
+
+__all__ = ["extract_receipt_fields"]
*** End Patch
